_comment: Muse Spark on MI355X, every TP8/EP8 config of InferenceX CI run 39659301076, as one campaign. The baseline adopts the CI run's own artifacts per config (no local replay); profile extracts each config from its own CI serving log and merges them so each task gets ONE UT in which every config weighs the same; kernel selection is an operator's share of this EP group's workload, >5%; applyback measures the group's lowest- and highest-concurrency configs against their own CI numbers. One EP group per campaign: a TP4/EP4 group is a sibling config with select.ep [4].

params.selection: Multi-config, per config then union. In each config (its own workload), by operator: phase Top 10 AND whole-workload share > 5% (rank first, then filter; no backfill); an operator selected in any config is a candidate (multi_config.py select --group-dir $OUT). Each task's seam above the M-dependent path selection; the UT pools only the configs the operator runs in. See stages/profile/README.md 'Several configs'.

params._note_point_serving_env: Per representative point id (baseline.json representative): an env file with that config's launch settings (KV offload, speculative decoding, ...). CONC and TP are taken from the point's CI config and win over the file.
